title: AI Attacked
textBlocks:
Surprise Attack
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s lesson we see the 
Lord gives them a plan 
to win the battle against their enemy.
The plan is to attack them by surprise!

The Lord tells Joshua about a special way to beat the baddies.
Joshua must take ALL his men into battle this time.
Then some of them must hide 
while the rest of them will pretend to be weak and scared
They win because they listened to God’s plan!

TALK TO JESUS
Dear Jesus
Thank you for looking after me
Thank you for caring about me and loving me
Please help me to listen to You
Amen
